name: Benchmark-Images-for-Stable-Diffusion-Bias
description: A curated set of images intended to probe and quantify biases exhibited by Stable Diffusion and similar text-to-image models across demographic and attribute prompts. The dataset is used for human and automated evaluations of generation outputs to identify stereotypical, biased, or otherwise problematic visual representations. It is primarily aimed at fairness and safety analysis of image-generation models.
evaluation_method: human_eval (annotator judgments) and bias rate / proportion of biased outputs
general_score_metric: bias rate (proportion of generated outputs judged biased/problematic by annotators)
reputation: A small, focused dataset used in fairness analyses of text-to-image systems with modest recognition in the safety/fairness subcommunity.
